title: Connection Pool Config Compiler
description: Compiles PgBouncer (or equivalent) connection pool configuration. Enforces: valid pool mode, total pool sizes within instance max_connections, max_client_connections above pool total, scram-sha-256 auth, health check query defined, reserve pool non-zero, and idle timeout set.

error_codes.CPC001: connection-pool-config.json missing or invalid — required fields: pool_mode, pools[], max_client_connections, auth_type, health_check_query
error_codes.CPC002: pool_mode is invalid — must be one of: session | transaction | statement
error_codes.CPC003: Sum of pool sizes exceeds instance max_connections — total pool size must be ≤ (max_connections − reserved system connections)
error_codes.CPC004: max_client_connections is not greater than total pool size — clients must be able to queue without hard-failing
error_codes.CPC005: auth_type is md5 (deprecated) — use scram-sha-256 for all connection pool authentication
error_codes.CPC006: health_check_query is not defined — pool must have a query to verify backend connections are alive
error_codes.CPC007: reserve_pool_size is zero — reserve pool must be > 0 to handle connection spikes without rejection
error_codes.CPC008: server_idle_timeout is not defined or is zero — idle connections must have a timeout to prevent resource leaks
